d:
A fragment of the shattered medallion is all that I can offer.
You must find another of dragon blood willing to assist you in forging a new key. Once you secure this key, you must travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. It is there that you will find her lair, friend.
Where to find other flights willing to help? Sadly, I do not know... They are said to exist. Some may even work and live among us, disguised as one of the humanoid races. I wish you luck.
human-male
p: I sense an aura of evil radiating from you, traveler. What could you hold that emits such an aura?
highelf-female
c: I should have known - a piece of the black dragon brood mother, Onyxia. How revolting...
highelf-female

d:
It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. Shattered, it is useless.
It is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. There is one... He is known as General Drakkisath, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of Nefarian. Perhaps you have heard of him?
Return with his blood, traveler, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to Onyxia's lair.
highelf-female
p: The flow of time does not stop or slow, traveler. While my life is eternal, yours is not. Waste not the time that you have...
highelf-female
c:
This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. The lair of Onyxia can be found in Dustwallow Marsh. As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.
The Blue Flight wishes you luck, friend.
highelf-female

d:
We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest. We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!
Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing. Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
troll-male
p: I await reports of your outrunner kills, friend.
troll-male
c:
Very good, friend. Your hunting skills are impressive...
The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
troll-male

d:
I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.
The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... But I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
orc-female
p: I hope you find the pages soon, friend! I really need to get back to work!
orc-female
c: Reading isn't my strong point... But now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, friend!
orc-female

d:
Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.
His presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.
Find Malcin and slay him, friend. Return to me after the deed is done.
p:
Have you found the Ambassador, friend? Is he dead?
We cannot afford to allow the Scourge to take a foothold on Kalimdor. They are enough of a threat to our own borders to have to deal with them on two fronts.
The only optimistic sign from the events you've told me about is that the crone seemed uncorrupted. She must know deep in her spirit that the Scourge may bring great power, but that the Barrens would not truly be hers if she were to agree to their deal.
c:
Good. Well done, adventurer.
Now that Malcin is dead, we can at least know that the Scourges advances will be halted. The Dark Lady thanks you for your efforts and wishes to reward you with a gift.
Although we do not know the extent of the Scourges influence within the Downs, I am sure we will discover their plots soon enough.

d:
My Lady,
You know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.
Please, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.
Best Regards,
Ambassador Malcin
p: What business is it you wish to speak of, friend? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.
c:
I recognize the insignia on this scroll, friend. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.
The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... Changed.
If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.

d:
Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.
My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
tauren-female
c: Kaya is alive! Friend, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
tauren-male

d:
Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
orc-male
c: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
orc-male

d:
Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
orc-male
c: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
orc-male

d:
I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.
Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.
Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
orc-male
p: Hurry, friend. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
orc-male
c: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
orc-male

d:
Hey! Adventurer! Come here!
My raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west. Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire. Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors. The battle will be glorious!
Do you want to share in the glory, friend, and aid us? If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.
What do you say. Are you with us?
orc-male
p: Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. Was the attack successful?
orc-male
c:
So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, friend. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...
And I hope you gained a scar or two!
orc-male

p:
So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will.
You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, friend. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here.
But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
orc-male
c: Well, my update will explain all of this to Kadrak. You must return this to him as quickly as possible.
orc-male

p:
Much danger lies along this path, friend. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.
We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale. I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.
It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, friend.
orc-female
c: Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, friend.
orc-female

p:
Keep an eye out, traveler. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...
We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.
I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?
orc-female
c: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
orc-female

d:
The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.
Friend, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
tauren-male
p: Have you killed them yet?
tauren-male
c: Friend, I thank you... But I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
tauren-male

d:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!
Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.
Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.
The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.
Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, friend, please.
nightelf-male
p:
May the Earthmother be with you, friend.
Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
tauren-female
c:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.
For some time they considered him dead or missing.
By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, friend.
Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!
You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, friend.
tauren-female

d: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, friend. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
c: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
troll-male

d:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.
Will you help me, friend? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
troll-male
p: How goes your search for the crystals, friend? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
troll-male
c:
Well done, friend. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...
I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... Well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
troll-male

d:
Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:
"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.
By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
p: Yes, friend? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
troll-male
c:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.
Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
troll-male

d:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods—creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, friend. I cannot do it myself—I am too weak.
Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
troll-male
p: Have you found him yet, friend? Lorgus must be stopped!
troll-male
c:
Very good!! Thank you, friend. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.
Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
troll-male

d:
It is good to see you again, friend. The wind carries with it news from the Eastern Kingdom.
Sit, listen.
orc-male
p: Patience, friend. Pay attention!
orc-male
c: Are you prepared to take on this task?
orc-male

d:
I have received word from one of my champions that a way into the lair of the dragon may exist. You are to seek him out.
Rexxar wanders the desert wasteland of Desolace, traveling between Stonetalon and Feralas. He awaits your arrival.
orc-male
c:
There is but one way into the dragon's lair, traveler.
You see, only the strongest of the Black Dragonflight are allowed entry into the lair of the brood mother. Many trials must be passed and the key to enter ceremoniously enchanted by General Drakkisath himself!
Since you are not of black dragonkin, you may have some difficulty in obtaining passage.
orc-male

d:
What do you know of illusions, friend? For you see, it is an illusion that you must create in order to circumvent the Black Flight's defenses.
I know of one that may be willing to assist you in your quest of deception. She has assisted our kind in the past when she has deemed the cause worthy.
In the Western Plaguelands you will find Myranda the Hag, master illusionist - an exile of the Lordaeron alliance. Travel there and take with you this message.
orc-male
p: It is not often I see one of the Horde in these parts of Lordaeron. What is it that you have for Myranda?
gnome-female
c:
How is he? Rexxar, I mean. Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!
Oh, nevermind! Myranda will help you, traveler. I owe the Warchief a favor or two.
gnome-female

d:
So the traveler wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?
The creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. Rexxar and the Warchief have entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.
Travel to the upper citadel of Blackrock Spire and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.
Return to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.
gnome-female
p:
The eyes of that which we wish to mimic are the most important ingredient of any illusion, friend.
Myranda points to a bag almost overflowing with eyeballs labeled 'Scarlet Crusade.'
gnome-female
c:
Let Myranda have a look, traveler.
Oh yes, these will do nicely.
With these reagents, Myranda will create for you a medallion that will grant an illusion capable of fooling the black dragonflight's gatekeeper.
gnome-female

d:
I have attuned this medallion with the magic necessary to create and maintain an illusion within the bounds of the den of Emberstrife.
Emberstrife is an ancient drake; an old gatekeeper of Nefarian, burdened with the duty to test those dragonspawn that would ascend to the rank of elite guard to Onyxia.
Travel to the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh and enter the lair of Emberstrife. Once there, put on the amulet and follow where your destiny may lead!
gnome-female
c: Have we run so low on able soldiers that Nefarian is sending me whelps? You will never pass my tests, broodling.

d:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!
Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.
Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!
Can you help me?
orc-male
p: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
orc-male
c:
Excellent, friend. You've saved me a lot of work!
But don't think that I'm not grateful!
orc-male

d:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.
..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!
What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.
So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
goblin-female
p:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.
..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!
What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.
So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
goblin-female
c: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.
goblin-female

d:
We are Deathwing's children, whelp. Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced.
If you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence.
Find their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father!
Travel to Winterspring and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. Tear out his skull and return it to me.
c: One of ssseveral complete...

d:
Just as our Father crushes the Aspects themselves, so too must we strive to bring chaos and destruction to their children.
You must test your battle prowess against the sleepless dreamers: The children of the Green Flight.
Travel to the Swamp of Sorrows and track down Somnus, drake champion of the Green Flight. Let flow your hatred; dominate the insect... Return to me with his skull...
p: Do not return here until you have bathed in the blood of our enemies and drank in their suffering.
c: Another complete...

d:
The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...
It is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.
Ssstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.
p: Ironically, whelp, time is of the essencccce.
c: The most hated remainsss...

d:
It was over the mountains of Grim Batol that our Father raged against the combined might of the Aspects. The cowardly act of the betrayer, Alexstrasza, bought the other Aspects enough time to escape from Father's wrath.
Sssuch a shameful act...
The Red Flight now guards Grim Batol, their lieutenant, Axtroz, must be destroyed. Return the skull of Axtroz to me. For Father, whelp!
p: Changesss... I sense them taking place in you, whelp. Pass this test and only ceremony remains.
c:
I had doubted your dedication, whelp. You persisted, dominating our enemies, bringing honor to our flight.
I must now prepare the skulls for your ascension.
